# 0.24.1 — 10 November 2026

Patch release on 0.24.0. `pip install opentide` works again: Typer 0.29.0 made opentide crash on start.

## Upgrade

```bash
pip install opentide==0.24.1
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

| Before | Now |
|--------|-----|
| A fresh `pip install opentide` (0.24.0 or earlier) pulled Typer 0.29.0, and `opentide setup`, `opentide commands` and the language server crashed with `No module named 'typer._types'` | opentide requires `typer>=0.27.0,<0.29` and runs |

It is a patch because it restores documented behaviour without changing input, output or generated files.

## Fixed

- **`pip install opentide` no longer installs a Typer that crashes it.** Typer 0.29.0 removed private modules and options opentide's CLI is built on. opentide now requires `typer>=0.27.0,<0.29`, and `setup ci` declares its providers with Typer's public API. An invalid provider names the valid ones and suggests the closest.
- **The diagnostic codes reference publishes on opentide.org again.** The page for `cql_link_outside_correlate` named the CQL operator `<=>` in plain text, which the site's docs format reads as a broken tag. The reference now escapes it, and `scripts/validate-docs.sh` fails on docs text the site cannot render.

See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/blob/development/CHANGELOG.md#0241--2026-11-10) for every change.

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.24.1
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.24.1
opentide commands > /dev/null && echo ok                     # ok
```
